name: Lyra Payment REST API
description: Lyra is a French payment processing platform providing a comprehensive REST API (V4) for creating payments, managing transactions, handling tokens for recurring payments, subscriptions, and risk management. The API follows a resource/action pattern where all requests are POST calls with JSON bodies.
